title: Validate repo-local evidence refs before role_ready claim
mission: Repair the compiled role frontier so a role_ready candidate does not hand a winning worker nonexistent repo-local evidence paths after ownership. Preserve deterministic role identity and external evidence forms, but validate repo-local refs during compilation: resolvable refs remain bounded evidence; missing repo-local refs become explicit machine-readable control-plane diagnostics or suppress an unusable role candidate rather than causing post-claim 404 archaeology. Do not broaden preclaim reads in disposable workers.
definition_of_done: A deterministic regression includes a role trigger with at least one valid repo-local evidence ref and one nonexistent repo-local evidence ref.
The compiled role_ready contract never requires a post-claim worker to discover an unmarked missing repo-local evidence ref by 404.
External/non-file evidence forms such as github-actions: or gh-pages annotated refs are not incorrectly rejected as missing repository files.
Any missing repo-local evidence is preserved as explicit compiler/control-plane diagnostic provenance rather than silently invented, rewritten or treated as a valid source.
Role fingerprint/dedupe behavior remains deterministic and cannot be varied per worker to evade an existing role PIN.
The fix stays central in compiler/static/CI logic; /wc preclaim budget does not gain directory archaeology.
A regression/ratchet guard is wired into the binding allocator path, and no product Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
